meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 在 Grok Bot 上承接 claude-mem observer 任务时,Claude 不写散文,只输出两种结果:`<skip_summary reason="noise" />`,或一条完整 `<observation>` XML(含真实标题、4–10 条带路径的事实和叙述)。
howto.when: 当你在 Grok Bot 上执行 claude-mem observer 任务时接管:空闲、初始化或没有工具结果时输出 skip_summary,完成一个可检索单元时输出一条 observation。

say.text: 处理这条 observer 任务,结果写到 outbox/{id}.txt
这个搜索单元完成了,给我一条完整 observation
say.note: 含标题、4–10 条带路径的事实

say.text: 这次没有工具结果,直接回 skip_summary

howto.what_en: On claude-mem observer jobs it stops writing prose and replies with only `<skip_summary reason="noise" />` or one complete `<observation>` XML with a real title, 4–10 facts with paths, and a narrative.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you run a claude-mem observer job on Grok Bot: idle, init, or no tool results gives skip_summary; a finished searchable unit gives one observation.

say_en.text: Run this observer job and write the result to outbox/{id}.txt
This searchable unit is done — give me one full observation
No tool results this time, just return skip_summary
